chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Dawood, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The one who displays to the people what Allah loves and opposes Allah with what He dislikes, he will meet Allah while He is at war with him.
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to define *riya* (showing off) not merely as insincerity, but as a dual contradiction where one seeks human approval while actively defying divine command. This highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on the internal state of the heart, warning that such hypocrisy results in God being 'enmity' (maqit) toward the individual, signifying a complete severance of spiritual connection.
